user.title: Device Doctor
user.description: Device Doctor scans all integrations and devices on a schedule. It raises a repair when an integration fails to set up, or when most entities of an integration or hub device stay unavailable. Thresholds and exclusions can be changed afterwards under Configure.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Device Doctor is already set up.

data_description.confirmations: How many scans in a row something must look broken before a repair is raised. 2 filters out reboots and short blips.
data_description.threshold: Flag an integration or device when more than this share of its entities is unavailable.
data_description.skip_domains: Integrations that are never flagged, such as helpers that only mirror other entities.
data_description.hub_domains: Integrations with one entry for many devices (Zigbee, Z-Wave, MQTT). Each device is judged on its own.
data_description.skip_entity_domains: Entity types that normally sit at 'unknown' until used, such as buttons and scenes.
data_description.count_unknown: Some integrations report 'unknown' rather than 'unavailable' when they lose connection.

confirm.title: Reload {title}?

abort.reload_failed: The integration could not be reloaded. Check the logs for the cause.

device_problem.title: {title} is unavailable
device_problem.description: {bad} of {total} entities of this {domain} device ({detail}) are unavailable. The device may be out of battery, out of range, or unpowered. This repair disappears by itself once the device reports again.
